result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The environment is a mix of residential and commercial uses with street trees providing some buffer, but it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and has sightline obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is worn and may be difficult for approaching drivers to see clearly.
hazards.location_in_image: In the foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner can block the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street near the intersection.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban street with sidewalks and curb ramps, but it is dominated by a wide, unmarked gas station driveway that creates a significant conflict zone. The lack of marked crosswalks and the presence of large vehicles parked on the street further reduce pedestrian safety and visibility.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: The expansive, unmarked entrance to the gas station creates a large area where vehicles and pedestrians interact without clear priority.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks visible to guide pedestrians across the street or the wide driveway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large truck parked on the right side of the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across the street and the gas station driveway to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station entrance to slow turning vehicles and shorten the exposure distance for pedestrians on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the driveway and intersection to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps, but the pedestrian environment is compromised by faded pavement markings. The presence of parked vehicles near the corner and the lack of high-visibility crossing infrastructure increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right side of the street close to the intersection may block the view between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental or ladder markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve sight lines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, traffic signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide roadway width and lack of physical traffic calming measures like medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement in the intersection can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair and Re-striping
interventions.description: Repair the road surface and apply high-visibility lane and crosswalk markings.
